title: 2. What the Company Does: Segments, Revenue Mix & Concrete Examples
book_title: Inside the Delivery Engine: Verticals, Service Lines, and Real-World Workflows
question: Where does every rupee of Coforge's revenue actually come from across industry verticals and service lines, and what does a live client engagement look like end to end?

epigraph.quote: Clients do not buy generic coding hours; they buy domain fluency that prevents a flight dispatch failure or a broken mortgage settlement.
epigraph.author: IT Services Operating Maxim

web_blocks.html: Tier-1 Indian IT firms sell broad upkeep across nearly every industry. By contrast, Coforge builds its sales and delivery teams around deep domain verticals [1, 2]. After adding Encora on May 1, 2026, Coforge's Q2 FY27 sales hit ₹6,171 Cr ($652.2 million) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 [1, 5]. That puts its annual revenue run-rate above $2.6 billion [1, 5]. Five industry groups drive almost all of that billing [19]. Banking and Financial Services (BFS) leads at 25.3% of sales, followed by Travel, Transportation and Hospitality (TTH) at 20.2% [19]. Healthcare & Hi-Tech accounts for 17.6%, boosted by Encora's Silicon Valley product clients [19]. Insurance adds 12.8%, while Government Overseas (6.5%) and Retail, Manufacturing, and other segments (~17.6%) make up the remaining 24.1% [19].

web_blocks.takeaway: Encora and Cigniti structurally diversified Coforge away from its historical 30% aviation/travel concentration, elevating Healthcare & Hi-Tech (17.6%) and BFS (25.3%) into twin growth engines alongside TTH (20.2%).

web_blocks.html: Under these verticals, Coforge runs five horizontal service lines that earn higher rates than basic staffing. First, AI-Native Product & Application Engineering builds cloud apps, microservices, and Silicon Valley software, scaled by Encora [6, 16]. Second, Data, Analytics & Cloud Modernization delivers Snowflake, Databricks, MuleSoft (via WHISHWORKS), and ServiceNow workflows [2, 16]. Third, Quality Engineering & AI Assurance handles test automation and CI/CD checks, scaled by the Cigniti merger [3, 8]. Fourth, Intelligent Automation & GenAI Platforms deploys Quasar, Code Insight AI, and AgentSphere across 200+ live GenAI solutions [2, 16]. Fifth, Domain-Led Business Process Solutions (BPS) runs mortgage, wealth, and airline back-office workflows via SLK Global's 10,024 BPS staff [10, 19].

Coforge does not report audited EBIT margins by segment in Screener's tables [1, 3]. Instead, we gauge unit margins from management disclosures [1, 3]. Digital engineering, cloud data, and Quality Engineering earn higher gross margins and 18%–20%+ EBITDA potential [3, 5]. For instance, Cigniti's EBITDA margin rose from ~11% before the deal to ~19% after integration [3, 5]. The combined post-Encora firm also posted a 20.6% EBITDA margin and 16.0% EBIT margin in Q2 FY27 [3, 5]. By contrast, basic BPS and heavy onsite staffing earn lower margins. Coforge offsets that drag by weaving AI automation into SLK Global's banking workflows [10, 19].

web_blocks.title: Why Code Insight AI & Quasar Matter Commercially
paragraphs: In legacy upgrade deals, undocumented COBOL, Java, or mainframe code written twenty years ago slows down teams. Coforge uses Code Insight AI to map old code into clear business rules before engineers rewrite it for the cloud [2, 16]. This speeds up delivery and helps Coforge win fixed-price deals against larger Tier-1 rivals.

book_paragraphs: When you and I open the hood of an IT services company, the most dangerous mistake we can make is treating all engineering revenue as interchangeable. Writing generic web front-ends is a commodity; keeping a global airline's passenger reservation system alive during a winter storm—or automating a US regional bank's mortgage compliance pipeline—is mission-critical plumbing.

Following the May 2026 Encora merger, Coforge operates at an annualized revenue run-rate north of $2.6 billion, with Q2 FY27 sales reaching ₹6,171 Cr ($652.2 million). Look closely at where that revenue comes from. Banking and Financial Services leads at 25.3% (roughly $660 million annualized), powered by marquee relationships such as ING Group, SEI Investments, and Fifth Third Bank. Travel, Transportation and Hospitality—Coforge's historical crown jewel serving British Airways, Sabre, and SITA—now represents 20.2% (~$527 million annualized). Healthcare and Hi-Tech has surged to 17.6% (~$459 million) thanks to Encora's Silicon Valley and medtech client roster, Insurance accounts for 12.8% (~$334 million), and Government Overseas plus emerging verticals make up the remaining 24.1%.

Notice the strategic beauty of that mix shift. Five years ago, a severe shock to global aviation could destabilize nearly a third of Coforge's revenue. Today, travel sits at roughly one-fifth of the pie, balanced by regulated banking, P&C insurance, healthcare software, and multi-year UK public-sector transformation contracts—including a landmark $230 million UK government win signed in Q2 FY27.

book_subsections.title: Five Horizontal Engines Behind the Vertical Facade
paragraphs: If verticals are how Coforge sells to chief information officers, horizontal service lines are how it delivers and defends margins. First is AI-Native Product and Application Engineering, dramatically expanded by Encora's Silicon Valley and Latin American teams. Second is Data, Analytics, and Cloud Modernization—building enterprise data meshes on Snowflake and Databricks alongside MuleSoft API integration from WHISHWORKS and ServiceNow workflows.

Third is Quality Engineering and AI Assurance, scaled through the Cigniti Technologies amalgamation. Historically, Cigniti had never signed a large enterprise deal in twenty-five years as a standalone testing vendor and earned ~11% EBITDA margins. Inside Coforge's vertical sales engine, Cigniti's EBITDA margins expanded to ~19%, its top two accounts tripled from ~$25 million combined to ~$75 million, and automated QA became a standard wedge in large transformation bids.

Fourth is Intelligent Automation and GenAI platforms—specifically Quasar GenAI, Code Insight AI for reverse-engineering undocumented legacy COBOL and Java mainframes, and AgentSphere for multi-agent enterprise orchestration, with over 200 GenAI solutions deployed. Fifth is Domain-Led Business Process Solutions, staffed by 10,024 BPS specialists inherited largely from SLK Global, handling high-touch mortgage underwriting, wealth operations, and airline back-office exceptions.

callouts.title: Services Purity Over Software Licenses
callouts.text: Coforge deliberately avoids competing with enterprise software vendors like Guidewire, Duck Creek, or Sapiens. By divesting AdvantageGo in April 2025 for GBP 43 million, it ensured that software platform owners view Coforge as a trusted implementation ally rather than a rival.

book_subsections.title: Walking Through Live Client Workflows End to End
paragraphs: Let us trace two concrete engagements so you can picture how Coforge earns its fees. Consider a US regional bank struggling with slow mortgage origination and fragmented KYC compliance. Coforge does not simply send fifty junior programmers. Its MuleSoft specialists connect the bank's legacy mainframe to modern cloud APIs, its data engineers build a Snowflake compliance layer, and its Tier-3 Indian BPS teams process underwriting exceptions under service-level-agreement outcome pricing.

Now picture a global Tier-1 airline facing a winter weather disruption. Passenger reservation systems, crew-rostering engines, and airport baggage feeds must re-synchronize in minutes. Coforge's TTH domain engineers maintain those mission-critical interfaces while deploying Quasar and AgentSphere copilots to automate passenger rebooking and crew recovery. That combination of deep vertical memory and AI-assisted delivery is why clients stay for decades—and why Coforge expanded Q2 FY27 EBITDA margins to 20.6%.

book_subsections.title: Inside the Delivery Floor: Why Vertical Specialization Wins Renewals
paragraphs: Let us step onto the delivery floor to see why a global airline or a top-ten US retail bank chooses Coforge over a 300,000-person Tier-1 vendor. In Travel, Transportation, and Hospitality, Coforge does not merely maintain generic Java code; its engineers understand Passenger Service Systems (PSS), Sabre and Amadeus reservation architectures, crew-scheduling optimization, and dynamic baggage-reconciliation workflows. When a major carrier migrates its loyalty engine or real-time flight-disruption rebooking platform onto cloud microservices, a mistake costs millions of dollars per hour in tarmac delays and passenger compensation. That domain fluency is why Coforge's Travel vertical has compounded through airline cycles.

The same principle holds in Banking and Insurance. Through the SLK Global and Cigniti integrations, Coforge operates mission-critical back-office and quality-assurance pipelines—from automated mortgage-underwriting exception handling to Duck Creek and Guidewire policy-administration migrations. Meanwhile, the newly integrated Encora teams bring nearshore LatAm and US product-engineering pods that sit directly alongside client CTOs in healthcare, hi-tech, and digital commerce. By pairing high-touch onshore/nearshore product architecture with scalable India offshore engineering, Coforge captures higher-margin transformation work while keeping repeat-business rates above 90%.

book_subsections.title: Insurance, Government & Encora's Hi-Tech Engineering Footprint
paragraphs: Beyond Travel and Banking, Insurance remains one of Coforge's steadiest cash generators, anchored by property-and-casualty (P&C) and specialty-lines implementations on Duck Creek and Guidewire. Notice management's capital-allocation discipline here too: in April 2025, Coforge divested its non-core AdvantageGo insurance software product subsidiary to Sapiens UK for GBP 43 million, choosing to exit capital-heavy product licensing and focus purely on high-ROCE services and system integration.

Meanwhile, the May 2026 Encora integration added a major fourth leg in Hi-Tech, Healthcare/MedTech, and Digital Native software engineering, bringing roughly 9,000+ engineers across Latin America, North America, and India. For a global MedTech device maker or SaaS platform, Encora's nearshore pods operate in US time zones to co-build cloud telemetry, embedded firmware, and data pipelines—opening cross-sell lanes that standalone Coforge previously lacked.

book_subsections.title: How Cross-Selling Turns Single-Practice Wins into $10M+ Accounts
paragraphs: What separates a repeatable compounder from a project-by-project IT contractor is account mining. When Coforge enters a regional US bank or European insurer with a $1 million Pega workflow or Duck Creek implementation, its account partners systematically map adjacent bottlenecks in cloud migration, data engineering, and automated testing. Over three to five years, those initial footholds expand into multi-tower $10 million to $25 million annual relationships.

With Cigniti's quality-engineering capabilities and Encora's digital-product pods now integrated under one commercial umbrella, Coforge's cross-sell canvas is wider than at any point in its history. Every existing BFS and Travel client is a candidate for nearshore product engineering, while Encora's Silicon Valley and healthcare clients gain access to Coforge's offshore scale and managed-services delivery.

book_callouts.title: Why Mix Matters More Than Headline Size
book_callouts.text: When evaluating an IT exporter, always check whether M&A diluted or upgraded the client roster. Encora and Cigniti pushed Healthcare & Hi-Tech to 17.6% and cut Travel concentration to 20.2%, creating a more balanced, higher-rate engineering mix.
